what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Belgium, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11361 Afghan refugees in Belgium, 0.4% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1991 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Afghanistan from 2015 to 2025, and an interstate armed conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 224 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
These are year-end totals for Belgium only, reported to UNHCR.
